description: PROVEN (fz-k22.10 spike 5 final). Offender CallableId(35): capture_lanes=[] (producer demand judged the capture runtime-absent), so CallableDescr{function, capture_shapes, capture_lanes} (transport.rs:3377-3381 intern site) interns TWO distinct capture groundings of lambda FunctionId(181) to one identity. Its single boundary pools resolutions [Ty(453),Ty(21),Ty(440)] and [Ty(481),Ty(21),Ty(440)] (different capture Ty -> potentially different compiled ABI) IN ONE PUBLISH (immutable BoundaryDescr, seq-traced: resolutions complete at publish, zero later growth -- publish-then-drift and late-acquisition both REFUTED). Resolutions minted per producer at callable_flow_resolution_edges_product (runtime_demand.rs:2810-2817: activation_key(root, fn, capture_tys ++ grounded_surface)) threaded via boundary_resolution_symbols_for_flow_surfaces (transport.rs:4116). This is the SAME identity principle as fz-k22.7: callable identity must include the capture GROUNDING (or boundaries must carry per-resolution surfaces), so one boundary never describes a grounding the artifact never materialized. Relates to fz-k22.14 (the semantic-layer face of the same multi-grounding representation question).

comments.text: Implemented the producer-side identity split in the current worktree: CallableDescr now includes capture_tys, so empty capture lanes cannot collapse distinct lexical capture groundings. cargo check passes. Repro no longer faults on a pooled CallableId with multiple entries; it now deterministically reaches the next ownership violation (closure carrier capture passed to executable 65 whose body has two runtime lanes). This confirms the interner collision was upstream and that fz-k22.20 can next bind one target-owned ABI per now-distinct callable entry.

ACCEPTANCE ADDITION (from fz-k22.17's layer discovery): after the identity/grounding fix, a closure-lit DIRECT call's surface must present one value per semantic argument at codegen (multi-lane semantic args either decomposed at IR-construction or routed indirect) -- the require_direct_closure_call_arity_agreement guard (surface.rs) must never fire on legitimate code. It currently fails clean on the pooled-surface cases.

Retrospective batch audit PASS at aadab3a24: inspected the callable descriptor producer and interner identity flow; elided capture groundings are now distinct. Focused regression transport_callable_descriptors_keep_elided_capture_groundings_distinct passed. The isolated audit worktree passed fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --lib (1329 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored), and the targeted interp/run/build fixture suite.
